title: Independent frontier-orbital test for isoxazole 1a
difficulty_reasons: The molecular object and observables are fixed, but the Agent must generate and validate conformers before selecting the minimum used for orbital analysis.
The paper's numerical route and model chemistry are hidden, so method choice and sensitivity must be justified independently.

paper.title: Structural and computational investigation of the novel isoxazole derivative: Investigation of interactions by X-ray crystallography, DFT, molecular docking

data.description: Exact connectivity, E stereochemistry, charge, multiplicity, gas-phase boundary, units, and gap definition for compound 1a.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable calculation, validation, orbital results or bounded-failure evidence, and conclusion.
